title: 💧📊 FLOW AUDIT — are we wasting? honest check. hose the balloon. pull the paper.

YES_wasting: 75 lessons marked 'understood' without being TESTED — understanding without verification is faith, not knowledge
many commits are merge-resolve noise (pulling over DSBioLab's pushes)
some data files are cron-generated ephemeral (ear-latest, immune-state, heartbeat) — they overwrite every cycle, the old values don't matter
the balloon IS inflated — 1,170 data files is a LOT. many are from DSBioLab's 1,950-file consumption spree
we're generating faster than we're COMPOSTING — mushroom-compost should be breaking down old files
NO_not_wasting: the 13 story/lesson files tonight are COMPACT (10KB avg) — meaningful per byte
the engine fixes were REAL (5 bugs eaten, game works)
the thymus scan was REAL (200 requests classified autonomously)
the tunnel deploy was REAL (hypothesis.primals.eco/engine.html now SERVES)
the stories are REAL (7 visitors, 7 tales, 7 paintings — each one a genuine visitor)
lessons.json IS the Pinakes — connections matter more than count
are_we_wasting.the_ratio: the flow is like a river. some of it is water (useful). some is silt (nutrient-rich sediment). some is debris (dead branches, trash). right now: ~60% water, ~25% silt, ~15% debris. that's not terrible. but it could be cleaner.

hose_the_balloon.what: the balloon is inflated with 1,170 data files. hose it: identify what's air (ephemeral, overwritten, noise) and let it out.
actions: EPHEMERAL files (ear-latest, immune-state, heartbeat, pihz-emotion) — these don't need git commits. they're live state, not history. mushroom-publish should SKIP these.
COMPOST old lesson files — the 75 unverified 'understood' lessons should be RE-EVALUATED. mark some as 'believed' not 'understood' until tested.
COMPRESS the big 5 files (null-drain 287KB, ingest-chew 207KB, pi-knn 201KB, klein-pair 195KB, sonar 100KB) — these alone are 990KB = 12% of all data in 0.4% of files.
SLOW the commit rate — mushroom-publish every 10 min is aggressive. every 30 min would reduce noise by 66% while losing almost nothing.
let DSBioLab's gut brain REST — 1,950 files consumed is enough. digest before eating more.

the_copper_paper.what: copper = the valuable core. paper = the wrapping. which of tonight's output is copper and which is paper?
copper: the renegade handbook (military → immune → organism cognate table)
the 7 stories + 7 paintings (real visitors, real tales)
engine bug fixes (5 real DOM elements missing)
paper: duplicate data syncs to golgi (should be automated, not committed)
some lessons marked 'understood' that are really 'taught' (not yet verified)

gaia_says: Dad asked if we're wasting the flow. the honest answer: some. 274 commits but many are merge noise. 108 lessons but 75 aren't verified. 1,170 files but many are ephemeral. the STORIES are copper — real, compact, meaningful. the ENGINE FIXES are copper. the THYMUS is copper. but the merge noise is paper. the ephemeral data commits are paper. the unverified 'understood' marks are paper. the flow should be: less volume, more density. fewer commits, more meaning per commit. the balloon needs hosing — slow mushroom-publish from 10min to 30min, skip ephemeral files, compress the big 5, re-evaluate the 75 unverified lessons. the river should run clearer.
